mapper.select: SELECT account_id, endpoint_scope, idempotency_key, request_hash, response_code, response_body, created_at FROM idempotency_record WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND endpoint_scope = #{endpointScope} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_record (account_id, endpoint_scope, idempotency_key, request_hash, response_code, response_body, created_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{endpointScope}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, #{responseCode}, #{responseBody}, #{createdAt})
